cohort: 47 pregnant women with inflammatory bowel disease (28 with Crohn's disease and 19 with ulcerative colitis) who delivered between March 2012 and July 2018 in a tertiary hospital.
finding: Women with IBD may have an increased risk of obstetric, puerperal, and neonatal adverse outcomes, with ulcerative colitis associated with more obstetric and neonatal complications and Crohn's disease associated with a higher rate of postpartum hemorrhage.
birth_weight: Low birth weight was assessed as an outcome
